pages.title: fluid storage tank
pages.text: Fluid storage tanks allow you to store oxygen in a convenient, portable form. Holding down the right button will distribute oxygen to items in the inventory, favoring armor.

pages.title: capacitor
pages.text: A capacitor is a battery-like object used to store electrical energy in a portable form. It can be placed in a machine's energy tank to power them, and like a fluid reservoir, it can be allocated into your inventory by holding down the right click. It has two modes: sequential mode and polling scheduling mode. Sequential mode will allocate energy one by one, while round robin scheduling mode will allocate energy evenly. Right-click while sneaking to change modes.
